kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نؤتمن (form VIII)
# نُؤْتَمَنُ (nuʔtamanu) /nuʔ.ta.ma.nu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
# نُؤْتَمَنَ (nuʔtamana) /nuʔ.ta.ma.na/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunctive of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
# نُؤْتَمَنْ (nuʔtaman) /nuʔ.ta.man/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
